capabilities_classification.evidence: supabase/migrations/** contains no data_sources or source_registry table.
apps/api/src/services/news/sources.ts contains hardcoded FEED_SOURCES TypeScript array.
No global enum or check for OFFICIAL, DERIVED, VERIFIED, ESTIMATE, SCENARIO, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED, UNKNOWN.
supabase/migrations/011_delimitation.sql:15 status CHECK ('draft', 'final', 'superseded', 'rejected') confuses simulation with official draft.
scrapers/output/myneta/TamilNadu2026.json marks unheld 2026 election candidates as isWinner: true without SCENARIO flag.
No universal link between database records and dataset/version/source/transformation.
supabase/migrations/023_local_body_representatives.sql:404 representative_edits table records diffs and fingerprints.
supabase/migrations/006_trust_safety.sql:82 audit_log records user moderation actions, not data lineage.
No table or metadata tracking immutable dataset versions, hashes, or snapshot files.
Scripts in scripts/ and scrapers/ run imperatively; transformation parameters and intermediate diffs are not logged.
supabase/migrations/012_legislator_profiles.sql:254 scraper_runs table logs records_scraped, records_updated, and status.
Pipeline freshness in migration 019; domain dates in affidavits and bills; no temporal validity on geography.
Scripts in scripts/ (audit-data-quality.js, validate-data.js) are manually executed; no CI/CD data quality gate.
PII segregated in creator_kyc_records, action_fingerprints, trai_opt_outs with RLS; lack of metadata classification tag.
Quarantined in live_event_ai table (024); prompt-grounded in ai.ts; absent across articles and posts.

NewsAPI.details: Direct RSS XML feeds used; NewsAPI client does not exist.

Reddit.details: No Reddit ingestion, scraper, or API client exists.

SEC_EDGAR.details: No US SEC EDGAR ingestion exists. SEC references in repo refer exclusively to Indian State Election Commissions.

Binance.details: No cryptocurrency feeds, Binance clients, or market tracking exist.
